verdict.rationale: Make documents a Make AI Agents app for agentic automation inside scenarios, and API endpoints to create, update and run AI Agents, though these are in open beta. Nothing in the pack shows model selection or how agents call tools from within a workflow. The MCP server goes the other way, exposing scenarios to external AI clients, so it is not credited here. Missing for 10: model choice, tool use by in-workflow agents/LLM steps, details on LLM modules, GA status, independent corroboration.
